invocations.office: Order of the Markian Chapters
invocations.normalized_rubric: On Friday evening, at "Lord, I have cried," we chant the automelon stichera of the day, twice; and the Martyr-hymn; and of the Akathist on 4; and of the forefeast, 3. Glory: Of the forefeast; Both now: Of the Akathist. Entrance, Prokeimenon, and the readings of the day. "Let my prayer be set forth"; and the rest of the Presanctified. The four-ode canon of the Triodion we chant at Compline. At Matins: At "God is the Lord," troparion of the Akathist, twice Glory, both now: Of the forefeast. And the customary Kathismata, the kontakia and ikoi of the Akathist according to their order. Canon of the forefeast, with the heirmos on 6; and of the Akathist on 8. Katavasia: "I will open my mouth." After Odes 3 and 6: Kontakia and ikoi according to custom. After Ode 9: Exapostilarion of the Akathist, twice; Glory, both now: Of the forefeast. At the Praises: Stichera of the Akathist on 4, Tone 4, podoben: "As one noble"; Glory, both now, Tone 4: "A language which he knew not." Great Doxology.

invocations.office: Instruction Concerning the Feast of the Annunciation of the Most Holy Theotokos[^1461]
invocations.normalized_rubric: And if it is a fast day, we begin Vespers without Kathisma, and without prostrations. At "Lord, I have cried": We set 10 verses, and we chant in the Triodion the idiomelon of the day, twice; and the podoben, 3; and of the feast, 2, repeating two, Tone 6, podoben: "Having set aside all": "The pre-eternal Counsel"; Glory, both now, the same Tone: "The Archangel Gabriel was sent." Entrance. "O Joyful Light"; Prokeimenon. And the readings of the day; and of the feast, 3: First, from Genesis: "Jacob went forth from the well"; second, from the Prophecy of Ezekiel: "It shall come to pass from the eighth day"; third, from Proverbs: "Wisdom has built a house for herself." Then: "Let my prayer be set forth"; and three great prostrations; and the rest of the Presanctified. But if there is no Presanctified: At "Lord, I have cried," stichera: Podoben of the Triodion, 3; and of the feast, 5; Glory, both now: "The Archangel Gabriel was sent." Entrance, Prokeimenon, and readings of the day; and of the feast, 3. Then: "Vouchsafe, O Lord." At the Aposticha: Idiomelon of the day, twice; and the Martyr-hymn; Glory, both now: "Today is the joy." After "Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart": Troparion of the feast. Litany, and three great prostrations, and the dismissal. In the refectory, we dispense for wine and oil, on whatever day it occurs, unto the glory of the Most Holy Theotokos.

invocations.office: Instruction Concerning the Feast of the Annunciation of the Most Holy Theotokos[^1461]
invocations.normalized_rubric: At Matins: At "God is the Lord," troparion of the feast, three times; and we say three Kathismata. After the first Kathisma: Sessional hymns of the Triodion, both, without litany; and a reading of the day. After the second Kathisma: Litany, and sessional hymn of the feast, Tone 1, podoben: "Thy tomb": "The great commander"; Glory, both now: The same; and a reading of the feast. After the third Kathisma: Sessional hymn of the feast, Tone 3, podoben: "Awe-struck by the beauty of thy virginity": "Today all creation rejoices"; Glory, both now: The same. And after the reading, candles are given to the brethren. After the Polyeleos: Sessional hymn, Tone 4, podoben: "Joseph was astonished": "Gabriel from heaven"; Glory, both now, the same Tone: "Gabriel was sent unto the Virgin"; and a reading of the feast. The Anabathmoi, the first antiphon of Tone 4; Prokeimenon, Tone 4: "Proclaim the good tidings of the salvation of our God from day to day"; Verse: "Sing unto the Lord a new song." "Let every breath." Gospel of Luke, pericope 4: "Mary arose." After Psalm 50: Sticheron of the feast, Tone 2: "Gabriel announces the good tidings." Canon of the feast: The composition of Kyr Theophanes, Tone 4: The heirmoi twice, troparia on 12. Katavasia of the feast. But where there is a triode: We chant the canon of the feast, with the heirmos on 6, and the triode on 8. Katavasia: Heirmos of the Triodion, both choirs together. After Ode 3: Sessional hymn of the feast, Tone 8: "The Word of God"; Glory, both now, the same Tone: "He was sent." After Ode 6: Kontakion, Tone 8: "To thee, the Champion Leader," and the Ikos; and we read the Prologue. At Ode 9, the brethren again light the candles. "More honorable" we do not chant, but we chant the refrain of the feast: "Proclaim, O earth, glad tidings of great joy; praise, ye heavens, the glory of God." Then the heirmos: "Let no hand of the profane touch"; similarly also the second choir, the refrain and the heirmos; and unto the other troparia of the feast, the same refrain. With the triode, however, unto the troparia, the refrain: "Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee." Unto the Theotokia, we chant the refrains of the feast. Then the heirmos of the Triodion, and the refrain of the feast, and the heirmos, both choirs together. Exapostilarion of the feast, twice, podoben: "With the disciples": "Of the angelic hosts"; Glory, both now: "That which from the ages is known today At the Praises: "Let every breath"; we set 4 verses, and chant stichera, Tone 1, podoben: "Joy of the heavenly ranks"; Glory, both now, Tone 2: "The mystery which was from eternity." [If it is a Saturday or a Sunday: Great Doxology, and the litanies, and the dismissal.] But if it is a fast day: We chant at the Aposticha of the Triodion, the idiomelon of the day, twice; and the Martyr-hymn. Glory, both now: Of the feast: "Let the heavens rejoice." Then: "It is a good thing to give thanks," once. After the "Our Father": Troparion of the feast. Litany, at the end 10 great prostrations, without dismissal of Matins, and the First Hour with Kathisma. Troparion and kontakion of the feast; and at the end, 10 great prostrations, and the prayer: "O Christ, the true Light." Holy oil is also given to the brethren. The idiomelon sticheron is chanted, and the dismissal. At the Third Hour of the day, we go forth with crosses and with a procession outside the monastery.[^1463] And having returned, we enter into the refectory, and chant the Hour: The Third and the Sixth with Kathismata, without prostrations; troparion and kontakion of the feast. At the Hours, we do not strike the bell. At the Sixth Hour: We chant the troparion, the Old Testament readings of the Triodion, and the rest according to their order, and the reading. And we read the homily whose beginning is: "Again the joy of the Annunciation."[^1464] We join also the Ninth Hour with Kathismata, and a reading. After this: The Beatitudes, quickly without chanting, and without prostrations: "Remember us, O Lord"; "The heavenly choir"; Glory: "The choir of holy angels"; "Remit, forgive." After the "Our Father": Kontakion of the feast; "Lord, have mercy," 40; Glory, both now: "More honorable"; and 3 great prostrations, and the prayer: "All-Holy Trinity"; and the dismissal. And we chant VESPERS without Kathisma, and without prostrations. At "Lord, I have cried": We chant the idiomelon of the Triodion of the day, twice, without the Martyr-hymn; and the podoben of the Triodion, 3; and of the feast, 3, Tone 4, idiomela, which are at the Aposticha. In order, the sixth of May; and of the Archangel, three times, Tone 4, podoben: "O all-praised martyrs." To the eleventh verse, the refrain: "Who makes His angels spirits."[^1465] Glory, both now: Of the feast: "The Archangel Gabriel was sent." The priest performs the Proskomide during the stichera. Entrance with the Gospel. "O Joyful Light"; Prokeimenon, and reading of the day; and of the feast, two: First, from Exodus: "Moses went in"; second, from Proverbs: "The Lord created Me." Then the small litany, and the exclamation of the Trisagion; and the Trisagion. Prokeimenon, Tone 4: "Proclaim the good tidings of the salvation of our God from day to day"; Verse: "Sing unto the Lord a new song." The Apostle to the Hebrews, pericope 306: "He that sanctifies and they who are sanctified."[^1466] Alleluia, Tone 7: "He shall come down like rain upon the fleece"; Verse: "His name shall be blessed unto ages."[^1467] Gospel of Luke, pericope 3: "Elizabeth conceived."[^1468] And the rest of the Divine Liturgy of Chrysostom. In place of "It is truly meet," we chant the heirmos: "Let no hand of the profane touch." Communion verse: "The Lord has chosen Zion, and has desired it for His habitation."[^1469]

invocations.office: Instruction Concerning the Feast of the Annunciation of the Most Holy Theotokos[^1461]
invocations.normalized_rubric: At Matins toward the 26th day: We chant Alleluia, and the Triadica of the Tone.[^1472] But if it is a Saturday or a Sunday, we chant at "God is the Lord," the troparion of the Archangel, Tone 4: "Commanders of the heavenly hosts." After the first Kathisma: Sessional hymn of the Octoechos. After the second Kathisma and after the third: Sessional hymns of the Triodion. Canon of the feast of the Theotokos, with the heirmos on 6, Tone 4; and of the Archangel on 6, Tone 4. When the triode arrives, we chant the canon of the feast of the Theotokos and of the Archangel, with their heirmoi on 6; and the triode on 8. Katavasia: The heirmos of the Triodion. After Ode 3: Sessional hymn, Tone 4; Glory, both now: The same; and a reading. After Ode 6: Kontakion of the Archangel, Tone 2, podoben: "To thee, the Champion Leader": "Of the all-radiant and honorable and all-effecting [Trinity]." After Ode 9: Sessional hymn [exapostilarion], the Trinity Hymn of the Tone. At the Praises: Stichera of the Archangel on 4, Tone 4, podoben: "Thou hast given a sign"; Glory, both now: Of the feast, Tone 2: "Gabriel announces the good tidings." At the Aposticha of the Triodion: Idiomelon of the day, twice; and the Martyr-hymn. Glory, both now: Theotokion; and all the rest we chant with prostrations.

invocations.office: Instruction Concerning the Feast of the Annunciation of the Most Holy Theotokos[^1461]
invocations.normalized_rubric: At Matins: At "God is the Lord," the Resurrection troparion of the Tone, twice; Glory: Of the Cross; Both now: Of the feast. After the Kathismata: Resurrection sessional hymns, with their Theotokia; and a reading in the Explanatory Gospel. Polyeleos, and the sessional hymns of the feast, all once each; Glory, both now: Of the feast; and a reading of the feast. The Anabathmoi of the Tone; Prokeimenon of the feast; "Let every breath"; and the Gospel of the feast; "Having seen the Resurrection of Christ"; Psalm 50; sticheron of the feast. Canon: Resurrection on 4; and of the Cross on 4; and of the feast on 6. Katavasia of the feast: "I will open my mouth." After Ode 3: Kontakion of the Cross, and the Ikos. Then the sessional hymn of the Cross; Glory, both now: Of the feast; and a reading of the feast. After Ode 6: Kontakion of the feast, and the Ikos, and the Prologue. At Ode 9 we chant "More honorable"; Resurrection exapostilarion; Glory: Of the Cross; Both now: Of the feast. At the Praises: Resurrection stichera, 4; and of the feast, 3, Tone 1, podoben: "Joy of the heavenly ranks"; and idiomelon, Tone 2: "The mystery which was from eternity," with their refrains. Then the refrain: "Arise, O Lord my God"; and we chant the idiomelon sticheron of the day; Glory: The same; Both now: "Most blessed art thou." Great Doxology.
